title: Project Manager
description:
PMP,PRINCE2,PMI,or equivalent Project Management certification will be an added advantage

10-20 years of experience in utility-scale Renewable Energy Project Management (Solar and / or Wind)

Proven experience managing projects from planning,execution,and commissioning through final handover

Key Skills: Wind Project Management,Solar Project Management,Cross Functional Coordination,Project Monitoring,Utility Scale,Commercial Management,Project Governance,Risk Management
